verdict.line: You lose if you let Kled auto-trade you into his Bear Trap range while Skaarl is still mounted; you win once Skaarl dies and his all-in damage craters.

brief.thesis: Kled's Bear Trap on a Rope shares your Corrosive Charge's exact 800 range, so this lane is a Q-contest where whoever lands first dictates every engagement. Skaarl absorbs a huge buffer of damage before Kled dismounts into a far weaker champion, which is why the measured 48.4% win rate over 64 games sits below your overall 52.3% top-lane average — you're paying a tax for every game he stays mounted.

theirWindow.when: Kled mounted, Q and E both ready
theirWindow.what: He can hook you at 800 range with Bear Trap, dash in with Jousting, then burn four empowered hits with Violent Tendencies. Don't stand still at max range doing extended auto-attacks here — that's the exact window OP.GG flags you getting caught in.

yourWindow.what: Dismounted Kled deals less damage to champions and his Q becomes Pocket Pistol, a self-knockback poke instead of a hook. Commit your all-in immediately, before he rebuilds enough courage to remount with bonus HP.

still favors his all-in, R adds your execute threat

start.why: 87.1% pick rate and the sustain you need to survive early joust/hook trades without backing off wave.

boots.why: 75% pick rate; the flat physical damage reduction directly undercuts Violent Tendencies' four-hit attack-speed burst.

core.why: Armor shred lets your Echoing Flames procs and autos scale up through his Skaarl HP buffer faster.
Bonus health and the damage-reduction shield keep you alive through his all-in window before you can disengage.
Most-picked third item in the measured build path; stacking resistances outlasts his burst in extended fights.

situational.when: kled is building into pure AD and snowballing kills off you
violent tendencies' attack-speed burst is the thing deleting you in single trades

runes.keystoneWhy: Purge's rapid-fire hits stack the armor shred fast, which punishes Kled's lack of mobility once Skaarl's buffer is stripped away.

summoners.why: 76.4% pick rate at 49.1% win rate; Ignite secures kill pressure on his all-ins and burns through Skaarl's effective HP so he can't remount off the fight.

playing.title: Poke, don't auto-trade
playing.detail: Kled's hook shares your Q's exact 800 range, so fire Corrosive Charge from max distance and step back rather than walking in to auto-attack, which is the window he's built to punish.

playing.title: Save E for the dash-in
playing.detail: Hold Disdain to shield through or reposition out of his Jousting dash before he can recast it to dash back through you — don't burn it on wave clear.

playing.title: Track Skaarl's HP
playing.detail: The moment Skaarl's health depletes and Kled dismounts, his champion damage drops and his Q turns into the ranged Pocket Pistol — that's your signal to commit.

playing.title: Disengage during his W
playing.detail: Violent Tendencies gives him four empowered attacks with a bigger fourth hit; back off rather than trading face-to-face while it's active.

playing.title: Short trades until rank 4 W
playing.detail: The EWQWWRWEWEREEQQ order pushes Purge toward a 3-second cooldown fast, so walk in, Purge, and walk out before he can close with Jousting.

playing.title: Respect levels 1-3
playing.detail: His hook-joust combo plus Skaarl's HP buffer wins early skirmishes outright — play for wave control, not kills, until your cooldowns come online.

playing.title: All-in only when dismounted
playing.detail: Chasing a mounted Kled into his own all-in is how the solo-kill deficit happens; wait for the dismount window every time.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, summoners, and win rates are pulled from measured Urgot-vs-Kled games on the current patch (16.20.1); the mechanical reasoning — Skaarl's dismount window and the shared 800-range Q/hook contest — is my own tactical read.

stats.opponentTip: Bring Cut Down when facing Kled. Avoid being hit with his (Q) while using your basic attacks – [Q] contest lane.
